name: Routes To Target
description: A target group routes traffic to a registered target (target group -> instance, or -> Application Load Balancer when the target's id is that load balancer's ARN, as when a Network Load Balancer fronts an Application one). One edge per registered port, carrying the target's health from DescribeTargetHealth. A Lambda target is INVOKES_LAMBDA; an IP target waits on the IP address node's key (aws-core-tap#220).

port.description: The port the target is registered on (DescribeTargetHealth Target.Port).

health_state.description: The target's health as DescribeTargetHealth reports it (initial, healthy, unhealthy, unused, draining, unavailable, unhealthy.draining); null when health was not read. Changes in place run to run; not part of the key.

health_reason.description: DescribeTargetHealth's reason code for a state other than healthy (Target.ResponseCodeMismatch, Target.NotInUse and so on); null when none was given.

health_description.description: DescribeTargetHealth's description of that reason; null when none was given.

availability_zone.description: The zone the target is registered in, or 'all' for an IP target outside the VPC; null when not given.

discriminators.description: The registered port. In the key because one instance can be registered in one target group on two ports at once, each a separate route with its own health; set by the collector from DescribeTargetHealth.
